_why: The golden daily.note.md fixture pins the OUTLINE format on both sides, but
it structurally cannot pin the FRONT-MATTER: its TS half round-trips
tree.frontmatter verbatim and never calls the host's touchFrontmatter, so
outline.rs's hand-rolled line-based touch_frontmatter had no counterpart
assertion at all. These cases are asserted by BOTH sides —
through the `yaml` package) — so the two implementations cannot drift.
Known boundary, deliberately not asserted: a front-matter block that is not
a YAML mapping (`---\njust a sentence\n---`). The host returns it
untouched; the Rust side appends key: value lines to it. The plugin never
produces such a file (it only ever touches notes whose front-matter it or
the host wrote), so this is documented rather than fixed.

cases.name: a note with no front-matter at all gets all three keys, in order
the golden fixture's own block: updated replaced in place, unknown key and order untouched
a missing created is appended before updated is replaced, so the order is stable
a block with no updated key gets one appended at the end
an existing title is never overwritten, even by a different one
